profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Contractor for the Federal Aviation Administration
profile.summary:
- PhD in Physics with a concentration in astronomy, MS in Physics, BA in Physics, BS in Mathematics

-Currently a software engineer, contracting with the Federal Aviation Administration: past roles include data analyst, graduate research assistant and graduate teaching assistant

- Interested in engineering, data science, data management, research, outreach

- Past research projects:
     - optical confirmation of galaxy clusters using SDSS data
     - search for gamma-ray emission from nearby galaxy clusters and infrared galaxies
     - Managing and reducing data personally collected from national observatories (KPNO & CTIO)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Perform offline monitoring of WAAS systems through:
-system monitoring using MATLAB and Python tools
-optimizing said tools
-investigation of anomalies

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: provide business support through data analysis: project management, data verification, Excel, SQL

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Analyzing and managing data, writing IDL software for astronomical research.
Attended and presented at 5 science conferences, published 2 first author papers and 1 second author paper.
Active in OU astronomy outreach
Active in Graduate Student Senate outreach (Fall 2011-Spring 2012 and 2015)

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Taught various physics and astronomy classes:
Fall 2010 - Spring 2011: General Physics Lab I, responsible for teaching labs and grading lab reports
Fall 2011 - Spring 2011: Astronomy Lab & Discussion, responsible for reviewing class material with students, leading group discussions, grading for the course, assisting in course demonstrations

Full lecture course: Summer 2010: Physics II for Life Science Majors, responsible for teaching half the course, duties included writing and giving lectures, assigning homework, leading discussion sessions, giving exams and grading.

positions.title: Astronomy Lab Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for teaching labs at the Rafes Urban Astronomy Center (UNT Observatory) and Sky Theater planetarium, maintaining the equipment at the Rafes Urban Astronomy Center, training new Lab Assistants, and assisting in outreach programs to the community.

positions.title: Departmental Tutor & Grader
positions.description:
Responsible for tutoring various freshman and sophomore level courses in Mathematics in the UNT Math Lab, assisting students with daily assignments and preparation for exams.
Responsible for grading various courses in Mathematics. Responsibilities include grading daily assignments and quizzes, as well as maintaining the grade book for each class.

positions.title: Dining Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for serving food, cleaning and restocking the station, and cleaning the dining area of Kerr Cafeteria.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: Responsible for serving ice cream, preparing sundaes, working the drive thru window, working the check out station, maintaining the upkeep of the kitchen (dish-washing, floor-scrubbing, cleaning the front line).

educations.fieldOfStudy: Physics with a Concentration in Astronomy

publications.title: Constraining Gamma-Ray Emission from LIRGs with Fermi-LAT; Tentative Detection of Arp 220
The Swift AGN and Cluster Survey. II. Cluster Confirmation with SDSS Data
